changeClass.instructions: Classify the primary semantic type of the supplied bounded software change. Use only the supplied summary, component/path classes and deterministic signals; do not infer an unstated vulnerability or release impact.

criteria.bug_fix: The change primarily repairs behavior that was already expected to work.
criteria.feature: The change primarily adds a new capability or materially expands supported product behavior.
criteria.maintenance: The change primarily concerns documentation, refactoring, dependency/tooling work, cleanup, tests, or internal maintenance without adding a new product behavior.
criteria.security_sensitive: The change materially affects authentication, authorization, permissions, cryptographic handling, secret handling, trust boundaries, or another explicitly supplied protected security behavior.
criteria.mixed_or_unclear: The change mixes multiple primary categories or the supplied evidence is insufficient to choose reliably.
